name: 30th Anniversary Berlin & Beyond Film Festival
description: The 30th Anniversary of Berlin & Beyond Film Festival showcases the very best of contemporary German and European cinema exhibition in the Americas. Taking place across iconic San Francisco venues including The Castro Theatre, The Vogue Theatre, SFMOMA's Phyllis Wattis Theater, and Rialto Cinemas Elmwood in Berkeley, the festival presents independent works, studio pictures, topical documentaries and shorts. This anniversary edition marks a momentous return to The Castro Theatre, celebrating three decades of German-language theatre while fostering dialogue and collaboration among artists and audiences.
